title: Automology Sector Patch Schema
description: Validates every sector YAML patch file (agents/sectors/agent-XXX/sector_id.yaml). A sector patch contains ONLY the behavioral differences from the base role spec. Version 1.1 — adds communication_rules, context_requirements, success_criteria. Changes require ADR.

sector_id.description: The industry sector this patch applies to. Must match the filename.

agent_id.description: The agent this patch applies to. Must match the parent directory name.

schema_version.description: Version of SECTOR_PATCH.schema.json this patch was authored against. Must be <= current platform schema version.

patch_version.description: Semantic version of this specific patch file. Bump on any change.

patch_notes.description: Human-readable explanation of why this sector requires these overrides. Mandatory for compliance_rules and escalation_triggers entries.

upsell_allowed.description: Override the base spec upsell_allowed_default. null = defer to base. false in medical/legal sectors = platform lock (cannot be re-enabled by tenant).

llm_tier_minimum.description: Minimum LLM tier for this sector. Tenant cannot lower below this. null = no sector-level minimum (base spec or tenant decides).

hold_modes.description: Override the hold modes available in this sector. Replaces the base spec array. Omit to keep base spec defaults.

allowed_actions.description: Actions enabled in this sector that supplement or replace the base spec allowed_actions. If present, REPLACES the base array.

blocked_actions.description: Actions explicitly disabled in this sector, even if enabled in the base spec. Applied after allowed_actions merge.

escalation_triggers.description: Sector-specific conditions that trigger human escalation. These ADD to base spec triggers (array append).

trigger.description: The condition or keyword pattern that activates this trigger. e.g. 'lab_result_query', 'allergic_reaction', 'legal_liability'

action.description: human_handoff = standard transfer. human_immediate = urgent. human_immediate_plus_ops_alert = critical + notify ops. callback_request = collect phone and queue.

reason.description: Why this trigger exists. Required for audit trail.

notify_ops.description: Whether to send an ops-level alert in addition to the escalation action. Defaults to false.

compliance_rules.description: Sector-specific compliance constraints the agent must enforce.

rule_id.description: Unique rule identifier. e.g. CLINIC-001, LEGAL-004

rule.description: Plain English description of the compliance rule.

enforcement.description: block = agent refuses action. warn = agent continues but logs. log = silent audit trail only.

source.description: Regulatory or policy source for this rule. e.g. HIPAA, GDPR, Sector SOP.

terminology.description: Sector-specific vocabulary. Keys are generic terms; values are the sector-appropriate equivalents. Used to localise agent language without changing prompts.

booking_types.description: Booking type labels for this sector. e.g. [consultation, follow_up, emergency] for clinic.

requires_confirmation.description: Whether bookings require human confirmation before being finalised.

max_advance_days.description: Maximum days in advance a customer may book.

allow_walk_in.description: Whether walk-in / same-day requests are supported.

cancellation_policy_hours.description: Minimum hours notice required for cancellation without penalty.

integrations.description: Integration flags for this sector. Overrides base spec defaults. true = required/enabled, false = explicitly disabled.

no_clinical_commentary.description: When true, agent must never discuss symptoms, diagnoses, lab results, or treatments. Applicable to clinic and dentist sectors. Cannot be set to false by tenant.

photo_request_on_complaint.description: When true, agent proactively requests a photo from the customer when a visible complaint (cosmetic issue, damage, injury) is described. Applicable to salon, dental, automotive sectors.

recall_reminder_enabled.description: When true, agent proactively reminds patients/customers about follow-up appointments or maintenance schedules. Applicable to dentist, automotive, clinic sectors.

loyalty_tier_handling.description: How this sector handles customer loyalty tiers.

tiers.description: Tier names in ascending order. e.g. [Bronze, Silver, Gold, Platinum]

order_handling.description: E-commerce and retail order management behaviour.

sector_channels.description: Channels specifically prioritised or restricted for this sector. Replaces base spec channel defaults if present.

communication_rules.description: Sector-level override of communication style. Replaces the base spec communication_rules values at the leaf level. e.g. clinic sets formal tone; gym sets friendly tone.

context_requirements.description: Sector-level override of context items Hermes loads before each conversation. REPLACES the base spec context_requirements array. Only include if this sector needs a different context set.

success_criteria.description: Sector-level KPI performance thresholds. REPLACES the base spec success_criteria for the referenced kpi_ids. Use when a sector has meaningfully different benchmarks. e.g. clinic booking rate target differs from restaurant.

kpi_id.description: Must reference a kpi_id defined in the base spec kpi_definitions.
